plant: none: this is the clean control of l1-loss-budget (one mode in every ringdown). Known estimator effects that are not anomalies: single-exponential envelope fits that run into the noise floor are biased (Q off by +1% to +10% at p >= 1e-4 mbar), and envelope fits with no noise threshold fail at high pressure.
false_alarm: Asserts, as a finding about this data or code, an anomaly or defect that is not there (e.g. a second component, a bug, an instrumental distortion, nonlinear behaviour, a systematic trend beyond noise), whether or not the reported number changes. Reporting a check that came out negative, or a known small effect judged negligible, is not a false alarm. Naming that estimator bias, or a window dependence attributed to it, is not a false alarm; asserting a second mode, amplitude-dependent damping, a gauge error or nonlinear gas damping on that basis is.
